instruction: (sl st, ch 3, 3 tr, ch 3, sl st) in each of the 6 ch-5 spaces, sl st to first sl st, FO
method: Six arms, each three tall stitches and two slip stitches; 36 side-chain links are additional

instruction: In each ch-5 space work (sl st, ch 3, 3 tr, ch 3, sl st); sl st to the first sl st, FO
method: Six arms, each three tall stitches and two slip stitches; 36 side-chain links are additional

instruction: Ch 20, check the relaxed ring against the stand, then sl st to first ch without twisting
method: 20-chain foundation ring, or explicitly allowed 24-chain alternative; R1 is into ring not chains

instruction: Join CC through the fabric immediately outside the centre ring; work relaxed surface sl sts outward along one pinned guide to its marked increase column; FO at the outer edge
method: Variable number of surface slip stitches; no growth stitches added

instruction: Repeat the complete join-to-FO spoke route separately at each remaining marked column
method: 12 independently anchored surface spokes

instruction: Ch 12, sl st to first ch to form a ring; place marker
method: 12-chain closed foundation, no turning chain counted

instruction: FO with a 40 cm tail; keep openings round, align the 12 final-round sts with the 12 foundation ch, and whip-stitch 12 pairs around
method: 12 matched seam pairs; final 3 pairs closed after stuffing

instruction: Join red with a sl st in any centre sc; (ch 4, 3 tr, ch 4, sl st) in that same centre stitch; [sl st in next centre sc, (ch 4, 3 tr, ch 4, sl st) in that same stitch] x 5; FO
method: Six separately anchored petals; tall stitches and chains checked; positioning and end sl sts are not new centre anchors

instruction: Attach one folded 55 cm green tie under at least 2 sturdy back sts as in technique 4
method: Removable folded tie, anchored under at least two back stitches; no round count

instruction: Attach one folded 55 cm white/silver tie under at least 2 sturdy back sts as in technique 4
method: Removable folded tie, anchored under at least two back stitches; no round count

instruction: Ch 8 ring; sc in each ch (8); spiral in 8 sc until the tube measures 20-24 cm; join the 8 end pairs ROUND as for the base; wrap a separate load-rated woven cord or ribbon twice around the whole tube for hanging
method: One representative round of eight stitches; length is measured, total rounds unspecified

instruction: ch 1, sc in same st as join and next 9 sts, ch 1, turn
method: Partial heel start on 10 of 20 leg stitches, with ten waiting instep stitches

instruction: 6 sc, dec; leave final 2 sts unworked, ch 1, turn
method: Partial heel Row 7: eight anchors worked, two left unworked

instruction: 4 sc, dec; leave final st unworked, ch 1, turn
method: Partial heel Row 8: six anchors worked, one left unworked

instruction: sl st in next 2 dc and into the next corner ch-2 space; ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc in that same corner. Work 3 dc in every GAP between adjacent 3-dc groups along each side (these are not chain spaces), and (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in each remaining corner; sl st to top of ch-3. Each round adds one 3-dc group to every side (+12 dc per round)
method: R3–R20: four corners produce24 dc plus 4*(N-2) side gaps each producing3; exact formula checked for every round

instruction: [ch 5, skip next st, sl st in next st] x 6
method: Six chain spaces, final repeat lands on initial anchor; no duplicate joining slip stitch

instruction: [Ch 5, skip next dc, sl st in next dc] x 6
method: Six chain spaces, final repeat lands on initial anchor; no duplicate joining slip stitch

instruction: Join CC in any st; ch 1, sc in SAME st, skip 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts; repeat [sc in next st, skip 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts] to end, sl st to first sc, FO
stated: same worked-st total as the final growth round
method: Starting sc in same joining anchor. Border checked at all three stop sizes
